It offers three key contributions (i) a proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation for PQ; (ii) a new Extended Zador (EZ) estimator of the $k$-means quantization cost that is accurate in low bit rates and low dimensions; and (iii) a novel segmentation algorithm based on 1-d bin packing of global bit allocations. The result is a simple algorithm (EZPQ) with strong approximation guarantees. It matches OPQ's empirical accuracy while providing a per-instance distortion lower bound certificate under the Gaussian EZ cost model. items.description: arXiv:2611.31656v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ranks memory chunks by semantic similarity to the query. items.title: Beyond Final Answers: Interpretable Tumor Immune Microenvironment Reasoning from H&E and mIF
items.description: arXiv:2611.26794v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Readouts of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME), such as CD8+ T-cell density, intra-epithelial infiltration and the Ki67 index, combine tissue architecture from H&E with cell phenotypes from multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF). Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) could automate these readouts with an explanation, but two gaps remain. Pathology MLLMs read H&E alone, while these readouts need the cell phenotypes that mIF measures. And their reasoning has no step-level truth to be checked against, so R1-style reinforcement learning rewards only the final answer and leaves the reasoning unverified. items.title: CNTXT AI تعتزم استثمار 183 مليون درهم لتطوير الروبوتات وتدريبها
items.description: يشمل الاستثمار توسيع عمليات الذكاء الاصطناعي المادي في الولايات المتحدة والشرق الأوسط، وإنشاء منشآت لتدريب الروبوتات واختبارها في دبي وأبوظبي. نُشر المقال CNTXT AI تعتزم استثمار 183 مليون درهم لتطوير الروبوتات وتدريبها أولًا على البوابة التقنية .

items.description: تقول OpenAI إن نماذجها حسّنت مؤشرات تصميم دوائر AMD الرسومية بما يصل إلى 14%، وإن بعض التعديلات أُدرجت في تصميم أُرسل للتصنيع. نُشر المقال نماذج OpenAI تحسّن تصميم دوائر AMD الرسومية بنسبة تصل إلى 14 في المئة أولًا على البوابة التقنية .

items.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
items.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
